shapeSummary: Thin rectangular PCB plate, 30.48 mm (X) by 21.59 mm (Z) by 1.6 mm thick (Y from 0 to 1.6), centered in X and Z with its bottom at Y=0. It has two 2.18 mm through mounting holes along Y. The mini-USB connector, IC, SMD parts, pads and loose header pins are not modeled.
warnings: The 1.6 mm PCB thickness is assumed and not stated.
The mounting hole positions come from the image analysis, are accurate to about ±0.3 mm, and may need mirroring in X depending on the view.
The USB connector, IC, SMD components, through-hole pads and loose header pins are omitted because their heights are unknown and the pins are not attached.
The overall height is not given, so only the bare board is modeled.
The board dimensions are marked as unverified.
cadquery:
pts = [(-2.03, 8.51), (12.57, -8.0)]
plate = cq.Workplane('XZ').rect(30.48, 21.59).extrude(-1.6)
